A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 5-HT3 receptor antagonists have made a significant contribution in the control of chemotherapy induced nausea and vomiting, and to improving patient's quality of life.
, in most instances, both ondansetrons and granisetrons are significantly superior to the conventional antiemetic regimens.

, in the absence of data on comparative cost-effectiveness of the two 5-HT3 receptor antagonists, ondansetrone and granisetron should be considered as equally efficacious in controlling chemotherapy-induced emesis.

the use of 5-HT3 receptor antagonists is a cost effective treatment for the management of chemotherapy-induced nausea.
